title: BSNL’s Q1 loss widens to  ₹1,280 crore as expenses outpace revenue growth
summary: The company's total expenses rose 5.5% year-on-year in the June quarter to  ₹7,242.5 crore. The company's revenue from operations rose 4.2% year-on-year and 2% sequentially to  ₹5,306 crore.

title: Sensex falls 71 points, Nifty closes below 24,400; broader markets underperform. What lies ahead?
summary: The Indian stock market ended lower on Friday as Sensex dropped 71 points and Nifty closed at 24,366. Broader midcap and smallcap indices underperformed, falling 0.7% each. Analysts cite global yield uncertainty and oil prices for the sideways movement, while technical indicators point to key support near 24,200.

summary: The Indian stock market declined for the fourth consecutive day, driven by rising crude oil prices and foreign investor sell-offs. The Nifty dropped 0.12% and the Sensex fell 0.19%, with pharma sector leading losses, while only media and consumer durables saw gains.

title: Small-cap retail stock jumps 4% from today's low. Details here
summary: Patel Retail shares gained 4% on 14 August, supported by strong Q1 FY27 results. Revenue rose 69.7% YoY to  ₹309.54 crore, and profit after tax increased 37.57% to  ₹9.52 crore as the company expands its retail network with 53 stores across the Mumbai area.

title: Sensex, Nifty 50 snap 2-week winning streak on Middle East uncertainty, oil price volatility
summary: The Sensex declined 71 points, or 0.09%, to end at 78,009.25, while the Nifty 50 ended at 24,366, down 30 points, or 0.12%. For the week, the 30-share pack dropped 490 points, or 0.62%, while the Nifty 50 declined by 205 points, or 0.83%.
